resources.string: To keep a history, the app needs to read notifications as they arrive. Android asks you to turn this on in a system screen: find this app in the list and switch it on.
Everything stays on this device. The app has no internet access and never sends your notifications anywhere.
If the switch is greyed out or blocked, open the app info, tap the top-right menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
The app stopped capturing notifications because access was revoked. Turn it on again to resume the history; messages received in the meantime were not saved.
Some phones stop background apps to save battery, which makes the app miss notifications. Allow it to run in the background:
Turn on Autostart for this app and set its battery saver to \"No restrictions\".
Tip: open the recent apps screen, long-press this app and choose the lock option so it is not closed.
If notifications go missing, look for battery or background-activity settings for this app in your phone settings and remove the restrictions.
Could not open that settings screen on this phone. Open the phone settings and find this app manually.
